messages.subject: LSD values don't show up
parts:
Hello all!

I am new to the community and to the R world. 
I have been having some help to write my codes but two people I asked couldn't figure out why I am not getting the LSD values after running the ANOVA and I thought someone here would have the answer..

I initially used the melt and split functions, then 
lm2.cpds <- lapply(cpds, FUN = function(i) lm(value~(Vineyard+Bottle+TechRep)^2, data = i))
lm2.sum <- lapply(lm2.cpds, summary.aov)
cpds.lsd <- lapply(lm2.cpds, function(i) LSD.test(y=i, trt="Vineyard"))
